results.content:
### Is what I capture private?

Your private cards, reminders, voice, and photos are not sold or shared for advertising, and they are not used to train general-purpose AI models. Voice and scans are turned into text only when you choose to capture, and product analytics contain no capture content. When you choose Take Action, Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5 handles parts of the conversation and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Luna handles public-information research. OpenAI’s separate moderation service checks Take Action input for every account and, for a known teen account, checks the finished Sonnet answer before it is shown. Savor separately uses limited advertising measurement described in the full policy at savorapp.ai/privacy.

### Can I add a card to my calendar? [...] Skip to content

## Safety should live in the product, not just the fine print.

Savor is for people 13 and older. Teenagers get the same calm place to capture what is on their mind, with age-aware guardrails enforced around it.

01

### Age signals stay with the stores

Savor is for people 13 and older. On a fresh install, it uses an Apple or Google Play age range where the store says a check is required. Savor never asks for a birth date or its own age question, and a store-reported under-13 range is blocked.

02

### Teen AI output is checked first

When the store supplies a 13–17 range, model-written Take action answers stay hidden until an output-safety check clears them. If the check flags an answer—or cannot run—Savor withholds it.

03

### 3. Decagon

Decagon offers autonomous AI for tech-forward teams, built around natural-language agent operating procedures that give builders direct control. [...] ## What Customer Experience AI Platforms Actually Do

Customer Experience AI is software that analyzes, automates, and augments customer conversations. It does three things: it analyzes what is happening and why, it automates the conversations that should be automated, and it augments human agents with help in the moment. The strongest platforms connect all three so insight from one feeds the others.

### AI Agents vs Chatbots

An AI agent resolves a full task on its own, such as verifying a caller and completing the action they asked for. A chatbot follows a fixed script and usually hands off as soon as the request gets complex. The plain difference: an AI agent finishes the job, while a bot mostly points you toward one.
